entries.title: Proverbs 14:1
segments:
CHAP. XIV. 
 
  V. 1. Buildeth-Maintains and improves her family and estate. Her hands-By her idleness or sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:3
segments: V. 3. A rod-His insolent speeches as they are like a rod, offensive to others, so, they make a rod for their own backs.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:4
segments: V. 4. The crib-The stable is empty of food for cattle, and much more for man.  In the same sense cleanness of teeth is put for famine,
. The strength-By their labours, or by diligence in husbandry, which then was principally managed by oxen.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:6
segments: V. 6. Findeth it not-Because he doth not seek it aright.  That understandeth-That is honest and pious.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:8
segments: V. 8. His way-Consists not in vain speculations, but in a diligent study of his duty, and of the way to eternal happiness.  The folly-The wit of ungodly men, which is really their folly, is employed only in finding out ways of deceiving.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:9
segments: V. 9. Favour-They find favour both with God and men.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:10
segments: V. 10. Bitterness-The inward griefs and joys of mens hearts, are not known to any but a man's self.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:12
segments: V. 12. Right-There are some evil courses which men may think to be lawful and good.  The end-The event shews that they were sinful and destructive.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:13
segments: V. 13. In laughter-The outward signs of joy are often mixed with real sorrow.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:14
segments: V. 14. In heart-He who departs from God inwardly.  Filled-With the fruit of his ways, the punishment of his sins.  Satisfied-From the pious temper of his own heart, which cleaves to the Lord, he shall receive unspeakable comfort.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:15
segments: V. 15. The simple-A foolish man.  Looketh-He orders his dealings in the world with due circumspection, not considering so much what other men say as what he ought to do.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:16
segments: V. 16. Feareth-Trembles at God's judgments when they are either inflicted or threatened.  Rageth-Frets against God; or is enraged against his messengers.  Confident-Secure and insensible of his danger.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:17
segments: V. 17. Foolishly-His passion hurries him into foolish speeches and actions.  Wicked devices-One who suppresses his passion, but meditates revenge.  Hated-Both by God and men.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:18
segments: V. 18. Inherit-They possess it as their inheritance, holding it fast, and glorying in it.  Knowledge-The saving knowledge of God and of their own duty.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:19
segments: V. 19. The evil-Good men shall have the pre-eminency over the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:20
segments: V. 20. Hated-Despised and abandoned.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:21
segments: V. 21. Despiseth-That does not pity and relieve the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:23
segments: V. 23. The talk-Idle talking will bring a man to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:24
segments: V. 24. Riches-They are a singular advantage and ornament to them. But-As for rich fools, their folly is not cured, but made worse and more manifest by their riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:25
segments: V. 25. Souls-Such as are innocent, from false accusations.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:27
segments: V. 27. To depart-To preserve men from destructive courses.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:29
segments: V. 29. Exalteth-Heb. lifteth up, like a banner, makes it known and visible to all men.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:30
segments: V. 30. A sound heart-Free from envy and inordinate passions. Is life-Procures and maintains the health and vigour of the body.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:31
segments: V. 31. His maker-Whose image the poor man bears, by whose providence he is made poor, and who hath declared himself to be their protector and avenger.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:32
segments: V. 32. Driven away-In his death, from God's favour and presence. Death-In his greatest dangers and distresses, yea even in death itself.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:33
segments: V. 33. Resteth-Is laid up and hid there.  In the midst-In the heart.  Made known-They will publish in all times and companies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:35
segments: V. 35. Shame-Both to himself, by his foolish management of the king's affairs, and to the king who made so foolish a choice of a servant.
